_doc: Process parameters for the digital twin (and the simulator). Carbonate chemistry at 25 C, closed system (no CO2 exchange). naoh_feed_strength converts the lye feed setpoint (ppm of feed solution) into mg/L of NaOH actually added; calibrated so the normal setpoint gives finished pH about 7.3 for the normal raw water. chlorine_demand = demand_base + demand_per_ntu * turbidity.
